notes: Explore idea: dockerignore-explainer. Docker has no check-ignore; the engine (matcher.mjs) ports moby/patternmatcher v0.6.1 (ReadAll, New, MatchesUsingParentResults, compile) and tonistiigi/fsutil's filtered walk, with a Go-regexp-to-JS translator. oracle/main.go runs the real Go code over temp dirs; oracle-fixture.json replays 5,000 seeded cases in every test run (2,980 exclude something, 392 make BuildKit refuse the file): 0 disagreements; 25,000 more on seeds 7/99/12345 before recording: 0 disagreements (go1.25.0). Oracle-confirmed traps the tool reports: *.log is root-only; '**/*.md' + '!docs' leaves docs/*.md out ('!docs/**' works); [!a] is not negation; [^x] matches '/'; indented '#' is a pattern; one bad line fails every build. Plus COPY/ADD/RUN --mount bind sources excluded, secrets/.git/node_modules sent, and a fix re-run against the list (example: 12 fixed, 0 unfixed, 0 side effects). Upstream licences kept in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md + licenses/. Verification: venture tests 31/31; unwired_checks 279/279; run_workflow_locally --for-changes origin/main --foreground at 75f280e52: exit 0, 17 workflows, 155 run: steps passed (portfolio-validate 100/100, portfolio-pages 12/12, ventures-tests 5/5, pages 6/6, sibling-links 2/2, others all passed); secret-reading and write steps were held, as the tool does by default. Page checked in Chromium at 1200 and 390 px: no console errors, no horizontal scroll.
